name: mod_op
description: Modulus / remainder of a divided by b. Note: Lean's `Nat` modulus has the convention a % 0 = a (not undefined).
lean_statement: def mod_op (a b : Nat) : Nat := a % b

name: div_op
description: Integer (Nat) division: floor of a / b. Lean's convention: a / 0 = 0.
lean_statement: def div_op (a b : Nat) : Nat := a / b

name: divides_op
description: a divides b: there exists k such that b = a * k. Decidable for Nat via Nat.decidable_dvd.
lean_statement: abbrev divides_op (a b : Nat) : Prop := a ∣ b

name: gcd_op
description: Greatest common divisor of two natural numbers, via Mathlib's Nat.gcd.
lean_statement: def gcd_op (a b : Nat) : Nat := Nat.gcd a b

name: lcm_op
description: Least common multiple of two natural numbers, via Mathlib's Nat.lcm. Edge case: lcm a 0 = 0.
lean_statement: def lcm_op (a b : Nat) : Nat := Nat.lcm a b

name: is_even_def
description: n is even iff n % 2 = 0. Decidable since Nat equality is decidable.

name: is_odd_def
description: n is odd iff n % 2 = 1. Decidable.

name: coprime_def
description: a and b are coprime iff their gcd is 1. Decidable.
lean_statement: abbrev coprime_def (a b : Nat) : Prop := Nat.gcd a b = 1

name: mod_op_self_zero
description: n mod n is 0 for any natural n (including 0, since 0 % 0 = 0 in Lean).
lean_statement: theorem mod_op_self_zero (n : Nat) : mod_op n n = 0 := by simp [mod_op]

name: gcd_op_zero_right
description: gcd of n and 0 is n. Edge case worth seeding because it's a common LLM stumbling block.
lean_statement: theorem gcd_op_zero_right (n : Nat) : gcd_op n 0 = n := by simp [gcd_op]

name: divides_self
lean_statement: theorem divides_self (n : Nat) : divides_op n n := dvd_refl n
